walsh4.scope: Full dense Walsh4 output coordinates with unchanged ordinary packet sums. A failing source-frame inclusion is independent of initial target levels and scheduling. Packet refactorization or sparse mixed output bases remain open.

scope: This tests clone-free direct ordinary reads before selected output-basis restoration, with the original exact factory/packet sums and selected basis. Each failing read violates a necessary final-frame inclusion independently of read order. Other output bases, factory factorizations and partial reuse are not ruled out.
